subject: Simulcast Technologies Pvt. Ltd. — Official Company Profile, Products & Solutions
snippet: Dear Kalyan Karn, We are pleased to share our official company overview and product line catalog covering RF, IPTV, Fiber, SIMUL Suite, and AI Automation...
bodyHtml:
Dear Kalyan Karn,

Thank you for reaching out to Simulcast Technologies Pvt. Ltd. We are delighted to share our official company overview, product portfolio, and engineering capabilities:

Simulcast Core Product Lines:

  • Broadcast & Playout Automation: 24/7 master control, DVB-T2/FM transmitters, STL wireless links.
  • IPTV & OTT Streaming: Hardware/Cloud transcoders, catch-up TV, CDN middleware.
  • Optical Fiber Infrastructure: GPON/XGS-PON OLTs, DWDM optical backbones, BGP routing.
  • SIMUL Software Suite: Subscriber billing, GIS splitter mapping, bandwidth accounting.
  • Enterprise AI & MCP: Production Model Context Protocol servers and customer intelligence workflows.

Official Support: support@simulcast.com.np | www.simulcast.com.np
bodyText: Dear Kalyan Karn, Thank you for reaching out to Simulcast Technologies. Please find our official product catalog and capabilities summary attached.
